# Slash commands

Keystone's everyday actions without an AI model. Type `/` in the assistant box, in the command palette (Ctrl+K) or in
quick capture (Ctrl+Shift+Space). Changes use the same previews, Undo and git commits as the assistant; `/help` and
`/help <command>` show this list in the app.

<!-- Generated by scripts/commands_doc.mjs from keystone_worklog/static/commands/registry.js – edit those, not this file. -->

## How to write them

| What | Forms |
|---|---|
| Dates | `today`, `yesterday`, `tomorrow`, `mon`…`sun`, `last fri`, `next mon`, `+3d`, `-2d`, `+1w`, `2026-11-03`, `11/3`, `nov 3`. `/log mon` means the last Monday; `due:mon` the next one. |
| Ranges | `mon..fri`, `nov 17..nov 28`, `this week`, `last week`, `this period`, `last period` |
| Hours | `2h`, `1.5h`, `90m`, `2:30`, `2h30` |
| Projects | `#bridge` (any part of the name, or the network number); `#"Girder Bridge rehab"` for an exact name |
| People | `@Maria`, `@"Sam Lee"`, `@Maria[50%]` |
| Notes | `[[Note name]]`, `"Note name"`, `today` (Today.md), `this` (the open note) |
| Settings of a command | `key:value`, e.g. `due:fri`, `status:doing`, `in:Projects`, `plan:girder`, `title:"New title"` |
| Text after a target | `/append <note> :: <text>` |

When a name matches more than one thing (`#bridge` with two bridge projects), nothing is guessed: you get a button
for each, and the line under the box says what is wrong before you press Enter.

## Several at once

- **Lists:** `/log 2h #girder, 1.5h #cr12, 0.5h #admin yesterday` – a date at the end applies to every part.
- **Ranges:** `/log 8h #girder mon..fri` logs each scheduled working day (add `all` for days off too).
- **Chains:** separate commands with `;`, a new line or `then`. Everything is checked first, you approve once,
  they run in order and stop at the first problem; **Undo all** reverses them.
- **Bulk:** `/cards overdue -> due:+7d`, `/fus today -> due:tomorrow`, `/todos overdue -> done`, `/tasks late -> +2d`.
  Every item is listed with a tick box first, whatever the confirmation setting.
- **Pipes:** `/find bearing | append today`, `/actions this | todo`, `/grep TBD in:Projects | move Projects/Open`.
- **`$`** is what the previous command made: `/new "Pad memo" tpl:Memo ; /append $ :: Started`.
- **Routines:** saved lists of commands (Settings → Slash commands), run with `/name` or from the Today page.
  `{1}` is the first word after the routine's name, `{1|usual}` has a default, and a line starting with `?` is
  skipped when it doesn't apply. The defaults are `/start` (carry yesterday's todos, brief me), `/eod` (fill the day,
  show today) and `/monday` (last week's status note, cards due, overdue replies).

## Plain text

Without a slash, Keystone first tries rules (`log 2h to girder yesterday` → `/log 2h #girder yesterday`). With no
assistant model it then compares the text with example sentences using the in-browser embedding model and offers
the closest commands (it suggests at 0.6 similarity or more, offers choices from 0.45). Only a rule match runs anything
by itself, and only a look-up; changes always wait for a click. With a model, text that no rule matches goes to the
model. `/why <text>` shows how a sentence is understood.

## Today

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/today [date]` | Show a day's section of your capture note (Today.md). With no date it also opens the note. | `/today`<br>`/today yesterday`<br>`/today mon`<br>`/today 2026-11-03` |
| `/note <text> [#project]` | Add a timestamped line to today in Today.md. Also `/n`. Takes a list from a pipe. | `/note Called the county about the drainage memo #bridge`<br>`/find bearing \| note` |
| `/todo <text> [due:fri] [#project]` | Add a checkbox to today in Today.md. Also `/t`. Takes a list from a pipe. | `/todo Send the site photos due:fri #bridge`<br>`/actions this \| todo` |
| `/done <number \| text>` | Tick a checkbox in today's section (number from /today, or some of its text). | `/done 3`<br>`/done photos`<br>`/done 2, 4` |
| `/undone <number \| text>` | Untick a checkbox in today's section. | `/undone 3` |
| `/carry [from:date]` | Copy the unticked todos from the last day before today (or from:date) to today, and mark the originals “→ carried”. | `/carry`<br>`/carry from:fri` |
| `/day <date>` | Open Today.md at a day's heading. | `/day yesterday` |
| `/file-today [date]` | File the day's captures: #project notes into the project note, todos with a project or date onto the Board, replies into Follow-ups. Untagged lines get suggestions; nothing is filed by guess. | `/file-today`<br>`/file-today yesterday` |

## Notes

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/find <words> [in:folder]` | Search notes (and documents, when on) by keywords and by meaning. Also `/f`, `/search`. | `/find bearing replacement`<br>`/find drainage memo in:Projects`<br>`/find "load rating" \| append today` |
| `/grep <text> [in:folder] [re] [case] [docs]` | Exact text across the vault, line by line. Add re for a regular expression. Also `/g`. | `/grep TBD in:Projects/Bridge`<br>`/grep "deck joint"`<br>`/grep "\d+ kips" re` |
| `/open <note or file>` | Open a note or document by (part of) its name. Also `/o`. Takes a list from a pipe. | `/open load check`<br>`/open [[County meeting]]`<br>`/open today` |
| `/ls [folder]` | List the folders and notes in a folder. | `/ls`<br>`/ls Projects/Bridge` |
| `/map [folder] [depth:2]` | How the vault is organised: folders with counts, examples and descriptions. | `/map`<br>`/map Projects depth:2` |
| `/where <file>` | Suggest which folder a file belongs in (similar content and same-name files). | `/where "Inbox/girder_v3.inp"` |
| `/recent [3d]` | Notes changed recently, newest first. | `/recent`<br>`/recent 14d`<br>`/recent 3d \| append today` |
| `/templates` | List your note templates. | `/templates` |
| `/new <title> [tpl:template] [in:folder] [#project]` | Create a note, from a template if you name one. | `/new "Pad design memo" tpl:Memo in:Projects/Bridge`<br>`/new Ideas for Q1` |
| `/meeting [title] [#project] [in:folder]` | Create today's meeting note from your meeting template, next to the project's note. | `/meeting #bridge`<br>`/meeting "County coordination" #bridge` |
| `/append <note> :: <text>` | Add text at the end of a note (or under today in Today.md). Also `/a`. Takes a list from a pipe. | `/append "Bridge open questions" :: - Who owns the drainage?`<br>`/append today :: Site visit went well`<br>`/find bearing \| append "Bearing research"` |
| `/replace <note> :: <old text> => <new text>` | Replace an exact passage in a note (it must appear once). | `/replace "Load check" :: w = 18 kN/m => w = 20 kN/m` |
| `/move <file> to <folder>` | Move a note or file to a folder (never overwrites). Also `/mv`. Takes a list from a pipe. | `/move "Inbox/girder_v3.inp" to Projects/Bridge/FE`<br>`/grep "#bridge" in:Inbox \| move Projects/Bridge` |
| `/rename <note> to <new name>` | Rename a note in its folder (links to it are listed, not changed). | `/rename "Load check" to "Load check – girders"` |
| `/inbox` | File the inbox folder: suggestions from similar files, reviewed in one table. | `/inbox` |
| `/backlinks [note]` | Notes that link to a note (default: the open note). | `/backlinks`<br>`/backlinks "Bridge rehab"` |
| `/related [note]` | Notes similar in meaning to a note (default: the open note). | `/related`<br>`/related "County meeting"` |
| `/actions [note]` | Pull the action items (open checkboxes, TODO:, Action:, AI:) out of a note. | `/actions`<br>`/actions "County meeting" \| todo` |
| `/todos [overdue\|today\|week] [due:date] [#tag] [in:folder] [done\|all] [-> due:fri \| done]` | Checkboxes across the vault. Add -> changes to edit them all (each is shown first). | `/todos overdue`<br>`/todos #bridge in:Projects`<br>`/todos overdue -> due:fri`<br>`/todos due:fri \| append today` |

## Timesheet

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/log <hours> #project [date \| range] [code:LA] [ts]  ·  /log day [60% #a 40% #b \| usual]` | Add hours to the timesheet. Several at once with commas; a range logs each scheduled day; "day" fills what is left of the day. Also `/l`. | `/log 2h #bridge`<br>`/log 1.5h #cr12 yesterday`<br>`/log 2h #bridge, 1.5h #cr12, 0.5h #admin yesterday`<br>`/log 8h #bridge mon..fri`<br>`/log 8h code:LA fri`<br>`/log day #bridge`<br>`/log day 60% #bridge 40% #cr12`<br>`/log day usual` |
| `/hours [date \| week \| period \| last period]` | Hours logged by project for a day, week or pay period. | `/hours`<br>`/hours yesterday`<br>`/hours week`<br>`/hours last period` |
| `/left` | Hours still to log today and this pay period. | `/left` |

## Board

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/card <title> [#project] [due:fri] [status:doing]  ·  /card <existing> done \| due:+3d \| title:"…" \| remove` | Add a Board card, or change one that already exists (named by its title). Also `/c`. Takes a list from a pipe. | `/card Pad design memo #bridge due:fri`<br>`/card pad design done`<br>`/card pad design due:+3d`<br>`/card old duplicate remove`<br>`/actions this \| card #bridge` |
| `/cards [overdue\|today\|week\|all\|doing…] [#project] [due:date] [-> changes]` | List Board cards, or change them all with -> (e.g. -> due:+7d, -> done). | `/cards overdue`<br>`/cards week #bridge`<br>`/cards overdue -> due:+7d`<br>`/cards #bridge doing -> done` |

## Follow-ups

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/fu <from> – <subject> [due:+2d] [#project]  ·  /fu <existing> done \| waiting \| due:mon` | Add an email you must answer, or change one (named by its subject). | `/fu Maria – Bearing pad submittal due:+2d #bridge`<br>`/fu bearing pad done`<br>`/fu bearing pad waiting` |
| `/fus [open\|waiting\|all\|overdue\|today] [#project] [-> done \| waiting \| due:x]` | List follow-ups, or change them all with ->. | `/fus`<br>`/fus overdue`<br>`/fus today -> due:tomorrow` |
| `/reply <follow-up>` | Draft a reply: with an assistant model it writes the draft; without one you get a skeleton to fill in. | `/reply bearing pad` |

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/leave` | Leave balances now and projected at year end. | `/leave` |
| `/budget [#project]` | Project hours against their budgets, with the burn rate. | `/budget`<br>`/budget #bridge` |

| `/period` | Check this pay period on the Timesheet | `/period` |
| `/export csv` | Export the timesheet as CSV | `/export` |

## Plan

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/costs import` | Import costs from the ERP | `/costs` |
| `/share` | Share the project brief (review, then HTML or PowerPoint) | `/share` |
| `/brief` | Open the project brief | `/brief` |
| `/plans` | List your project plans. | `/plans` |
| `/plan [name]` | Open a plan on the Plan tab. | `/plan`<br>`/plan girder` |
| `/tasks [late\|critical\|milestones\|incomplete\|@person] [plan:name] [-> changes]` | Tasks of a plan; change them all with -> (same changes as /task). | `/tasks late`<br>`/tasks critical plan:girder`<br>`/tasks @Maria`<br>`/tasks late -> +2d` |
| `/late [plan:name]` | Late tasks and missed deadlines. | `/late` |
| `/critical [plan:name]` | The critical path (what drives the finish date). | `/critical` |
| `/next [plan:name]` | The milestones. | `/next` |
| `/task <ID> [50%] [+2d] [3d] [finish:fri] [deadline:12/20] [@Maria[50%]] [after:7SS+2d] [hours:40] [budget:$4k] [plan:name]` | Change a task by its ID (row number). +2d moves it 2 days later; 3d sets the duration. | `/task 12 50%`<br>`/task 12 +2d`<br>`/task 12 finish:fri`<br>`/task 12 @Maria[50%]`<br>`/task 12 after:7SS+2d` |
| `/whatif <ID> <changes like /task>` | What would move if a task changed. Nothing is saved. | `/whatif 12 +5d`<br>`/whatif 12 finish:2026-12-01` |
| `/addtask "<name>" [3d] [after:ID] [under:ID] [@people] [deadline:date] [plan:name]` | Add a task (after: also makes it follow that task). | `/addtask "Pad design" 3d after:7 under:4`<br>`/addtask "Agency review" 2w after:12 @Maria` |
| `/milestone "<name>" <date> [after:ID] [plan:name]` | Add a milestone on a date. | `/milestone "60% plans" 2026-12-12` |
| `/risk <title> [@owner] [due:date] [p:1-5] [i:1-5] [plan:name]` | Log a risk in the plan's Issues & risks. | `/risk Pad delivery slips p:3 i:4 @Sam` |
| `/issue <title> [@owner] [due:date] [plan:name]` | Log an issue in the plan's Issues & risks. | `/issue County comments late @Maria due:fri` |
| `/action <title> [@owner] [due:date] [plan:name]` | Log a action in the plan's Issues & risks. | `/action Send revised calcs @Sam due:fri` |
| `/decision <title> [@owner] [due:date] [plan:name]` | Log a decision in the plan's Issues & risks. | `/decision Use elastomeric pads` |
| `/cost [plan:name]` | Budget, cost to date, earned value and forecast. | `/cost` |
| `/free <range> [hours:n]` | Who has free time between two dates, across every plan. | `/free nov 17..nov 28`<br>`/free next week hours:20` |
| `/portfolio` | One line per plan: status, finish, progress, cost. | `/portfolio` |
| `/status [plan:name]` | This week's status draft: suggested red/amber/green with the reasons. | `/status` |
| `/close-week <green\|amber\|red> [schedule:amber] [cost:green] [scope:green] [reason:"…"] [plan:name]` | Save this week's status snapshot. | `/close-week amber reason:"FE model two days late"`<br>`/close-week green` |
| `/update [win\|problem\|decision\|contact\|site\|lesson] <text> [internal] [plan:name]` | Add an entry to the plan's weekly log (internal keeps it from the sponsor). | `/update win County approved the 30% plans`<br>`/update problem Pad supplier is late internal` |

## App

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/theme light\|dark` | Switch between light and dark. | `/theme dark` |
| `/go <tab>` | Go to a tab: today, timesheet, projects, board, plan, followups, leave, reports, notes, settings. | `/go board` |

## Reports

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/briefme` | A short briefing: hours still needed, cards overdue and due soon, follow-ups, leave, warnings and the notes you changed. | `/briefme` |
| `/weekly [last]` | Write the weekly status note (hours by project, cards done and due, notes changed, the week in Today.md) from your template. | `/weekly`<br>`/weekly last` |

## Help

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/help [command]` | All commands, or one in detail. Also `/?`. | `/help`<br>`/help log` |
| `/undo` | Undo the last change made in this chat. | `/undo` |
| `/ask <question>` | Send the text to the assistant model (needs a profile in Settings). | `/ask Why is the finish date slipping?` |
| `/why <plain text>` | How plain text would be understood: the rule that matches, or the commands closest in meaning with their scores (for tuning). | `/why log two hours to the culvert` |

## Routines

| Command | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `/routines` | Your saved routines (edit them in Settings → Commands). | `/routines` |
| `/run <routine> [args]` | Run a routine; {1}, {2}… in it are the arguments ({1\|usual} has a default). | `/run eod #bridge` |
